| τὸν δὲ χολωσάμενος Κρητῶν ἀγὸς ἀντίον ηὔδα (23.482, whole-line speech introduction) | "And him, enraged, the leader of the Cretans spoke to, face to face:" | "And the leader of the Cretans, enraged, spoke to him face to face:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); χολωσάμενος "enraged" follows the table's χολωσαμένη (3.413) and the name is withheld as in Κρητῶν ἀγός (4.265); ἀντίον ηὔδα "spoke … face to face" as in the table |
| κακοφραδές (23.483; vocative, κακός + the root of φράζομαι) | "ill-judging" | "ill-judging" | "foolish", "ill-advised", "witless"; built from the parts, the word is rare |
| δεύεαι Ἀργείων (23.484; δεύομαι + genitive) | "you fall short of the Argives" | "you fall short of the Argives" | "you are lacking", "you are inferior to"; δεύομαι "lack" with the genitive of what one is behind |
| νεῖκος ἄριστε (23.483; accusative of respect) | "best at quarrel" | "best at quarrelling" | "best in strife" (ἔρις keeps "strife"); νεῖκος "quarrel" as in the table (2.376) |
| περιδώμεθον (23.485; dual subjunctive of περιδίδομαι) | "let us two wager" | "let us two wager" | "stake", "bet"; the dual is kept in `l` and said in the note |
| ὄρνυτο (23.488) | "rose" | "started up" | "leapt up" (θόρε), "rose" in `i` (kept for ἀνίστατο, 23.491), "was roused"; ὄρνυμι "rouse", middle "rouse oneself" |
| ῥαθάμιγγες (23.502) | "drops" | "drops of dust" | "spatters", "specks", "flecks"; ῥάθαμιγξ "drop" |
| ἐπίσσωτρον · ἁρματροχιή (23.505, 23.519) | "rim" · "chariot-track" | "wheel-rim" · "track" | "tyre", "felloe", "tire", "rut"; ἐπίσσωτρον "wheel-rim" and ἁρματροχιή "the track chariot wheels cut", kept apart from ἁματροχιάς "clashes of wheels" (23.422) |
| λόφων (23.508; ἵππων … λόφων) | "necks" | "necks" | "manes", "crests"; λόφος "ridge of the neck", the note says so |
| ἀνεκήκιεν (23.507) | "welled up" | "welled up" | "gushed", "streamed", "poured"; ἀνακηκίω "well up" |
| κέρδεσιν (23.515; dative plural, of Antilochus' trick) | "by cunning ways" | "by cunning ways" | "by craft", "for gain", "by his profit-seeking"; follows the table's κέρδεα "cunning ways" |
| Νηλήϊος (Ἀντίλοχος Νηλήϊος, 23.514) | "the Neleian" | "of Neleus’ line" | "Nestor’s son" (the Greek gives it at 23.541 in full), "Neleian Antilochus"; a departure from the table's Νέστωρ Νηλήϊος (23.349) "Nestor, son of Neleus", because Antilochus is a grandson of Neleus and the adjective is not a patronymic |
| ἄνακτα (23.517; of the driver, "its lord") | "its lord" | "its lord" | "its master" (the first draft’s `i`; changed at review to match the table and iliad-147’s ἄνακτος "their lord’s", 23.417, 23.446), "its king", "its owner"; ἄναξ keeps "lord" |
| ἐς δίσκουρα (23.523; δίσκουρα, the range of a thrown discus) | "as far as a discus-throw" | "by as much as a discus-throw" | "a discus’ length", "a quoit’s throw"; δίσκος "discus", οὖρα "range" as in the table (23.431) |
| ὀφέλλετο (23.524) | "was increasing" | "was growing" | "was swelling", "was being helped"; ὀφέλλω "increase" |
| πολέος πεδίοιο θέοντος (23.521) | "the great plain" | "the great plain" | "wide plain" (the last part's wording at 23.474, where the verb is δίενται), "broad plain"; follows the table's ἔκαμον πολέος πεδίοιο θέουσαι (4.244), and the note says so; iliad-032 (5.597) and iliad-147 (23.474) have "wide plain" for the same words, a departure from the table row that this part does not copy |
| ἐπέτρεχον (23.504) | "ran close upon" | "ran close behind" | "ran over", "ran after"; ἐπιτρέχω with the dative of the thing run close to |
| ἀγακλῆος (Μενελάου, 23.529) | "renowned" | "renowned" | "famous" (κλυτός), "glorious"; follows the table's ἀγακλῆος Πριάμοιο (16.738) |
| ἐρωή (δουρὸς ἐρωήν, 23.529; "rush of a spear") | "by a spear’s throw" | "by a spear’s throw" | "a spear’s rush", "a spear’s cast"; the note gives ἐρωή "rush" |
| ἤκιστος · βάρδιστοι (23.530–531) | "least" · "slowest" | "least able" · "slowest" | "worst", "poorest"; superlatives of the adverb and the adjective |
| πανύστατος (23.532, 23.547) | "last of all" | "last of all" | "last", "the very last" (λοῖσθος is "last"); πάν- "all" + ὕστατος |
| ᾤκτειρε (23.534) · οἰκτίρεις (23.548) | "pitied" · "you pity" | "pitied" · "you pity" | "felt sorry for", "had compassion on"; οἰκτίρω "pity", kept apart from the Odyssey's οἰκτρός "pitiable" |
| στὰς δ’ ἄρ’ ἐν Ἀργείοις ἔπεα πτερόεντ’ ἀγόρευε (23.535, whole-line speech introduction) | "and, standing among the Argives, winged words he spoke:" | "and standing among the Argives he spoke winged words:" | "declared" (public pronouncement, kept for the prophecies at 1.384), "addressed" (reserved for προσηύδα); follows the table's ἔπεα πτερόεντ’ ἀγόρευον (3.155) "spoke winged words" |
| λοῖσθος (23.536) | "last" | "last" | "last of all" (kept for πανύστατος), "hindmost", "least"; the word is rare |
| ἀέθλιον (23.537; singular) | "contest-prize" | "prize" | "reward", "trophy", "contest" (reserved for the Odyssey's ἄεθλος); follows the table's ἀέθλια "contest-prizes" (ἄεθλον is "contest-prize" in `l` and "prize" in `i` at 23.411 and 23.440, and so here at 23.510, 23.544, 23.551) |
| δεύτερα · τὰ πρῶτα (23.538, 23.547) | "second" · "the first" | "the second" · "the first prize" | "the second place", "first place"; the plural stands for the prize in each case, said in the note |
| ὤφελεν … εὔχεσθαι (23.546; unfulfilled obligation) | "he ought to have … prayed" | "he should have prayed" | "he would have done well to", "if only he had"; ὀφείλω "owe, ought" (aorist ὤφελεν) with an infinitive, kept apart from ὀφέλλω "increase" |
| ἀφαιρήσεσθαι (23.544; future infinitive middle) | "to take away" | "to take … away" | "to deprive", "to rob"; ἀφαιρέομαι "take away from someone" |
| βλάβεν (23.545; aorist passive of βλάπτω) | "were hampered" | "were hampered" | "were harmed" (kept for persons), "were damaged"; follows the last part's ἐβλάφθησαν "were hampered" |
| ὑπερθύμοισι (23.512; ἑτάροισιν ὑπερθύμοισι) | "high-spirited" | "high-spirited" | "proud", "great-hearted" (reserved for μεγάθυμος); follows the table's ὑπερθύμοιο (23.302) |
| ἔλυεν ὑφ’ ἵππους (23.513) | "he unyoked the horses" | "he unyoked the horses" | "loosed the horses from under", "freed the horses"; the idiom is explained in the note |
| ἦ ῥα, καὶ Αὐτομέδοντι φίλῳ ἐκέλευσεν ἑταίρῳ (23.563) | "He spoke, and to Automedon, his dear companion, gave the order" | "So he said, and told his dear companion Automedon" | "bade", "commanded"; follows the table's ἦ ῥα καί "He spoke, and" / "So he said, and" |
| οἰσέμεναι κλισίηθεν (23.564) | "to bring it from the hut" | "to bring it from the hut" | "to fetch from his tent", "to carry"; οἴσω (φέρω) "bring", κλισίη "hut", -θεν "from" |
| τοῖσι δὲ καὶ Μενέλαος ἀνίστατο θυμὸν ἀχεύων (23.566, whole-line rising formula) | "And among them also Menelaus stood up, grieving in spirit," | "And among them Menelaus also stood up, grieving at heart," | "rose", "arose among them"; follows the table's ἀνίστατο "stood up" (the Iliad’s 23.491 is "rose" in `i`) and θυμὸν ἀχεύων "grieving at heart" (5.869) |
| ἄμοτον κεχολωμένος (23.567) | "unceasingly angered" | "angry … without ceasing" (+ note: the sense of ἄμοτον is not known) | "bitterly", "furiously", "insatiably"; follows the table's ἄμοτον "unceasingly" / "without ceasing" and κεχολωμένος "angered" in `l` (17.710) |
| ἐν δ’ ἄρα κῆρυξ χειρὶ σκῆπτρον ἔθηκε (23.567–568) | "and the herald put in his hand the sceptre" | "and the herald put the sceptre in his hand" | "staff", "wand" (reserved for ῥάβδος); σκῆπτρον "sceptre" as in the table |
| σιωπῆσαι (23.568) | "to be silent" | "to be silent" | "to hush", "to keep quiet"; follows the table's σιωπῇ "silent" |
| ὃ δ’ ἔπειτα μετηύδα ἰσόθεος φώς (23.569, whole-line speech introduction) | "and he then spoke among them, a man equal to a god:" | "and then Menelaus, a man the equal of a god, spoke among them:" | "godlike" (reserved for ἀντίθεος); follows the table's ἰσόθεος φώς "a man the equal of a god" and μετηύδα "spoke among" (9.16); the name is supplied in `i` only |
| ᾔσχυνας (23.571) | "you have shamed" | "you have disgraced" | "dishonoured" (reserved for ἀτιμάζω), "insulted"; αἰσχύνω "shame" |
| ἐς μέσον … δικάσσατε (23.574) | "into the middle … give judgement" | "give judgement openly" | "decide in the middle", "judge fairly" (adds); δικάζω "give judgement" |
| μὴ δ’ ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ (23.574) | "and not for help" | "and not to help either side" | "without favour", "not out of partisanship"; follows the table's ἀρωγή "help" |
| ψεύδεσσι βιησάμενος (23.576) | "having overpowered … with lies" | "has overpowered … with lies" | "having forced", "bullied", "cheated"; βιάομαι "use force on" |
| ἰθεῖα (23.580; feminine, no noun) | "straight" | "straight" | "just", "fair", "honest" (each decides what is straight); ἰθύς "straight" |
| ἐπιπλήξειν (23.580) | "will chide" | "will chide" | "will rebuke" (kept for νεικέω and ἐνίπτω), "will find fault with"; follows the table's ἐπιπλήσσω "chide" (12.211) |
| ῥαδινήν (ἱμάσθλην … ῥαδινήν, 23.583) | "slender" | "slender" | "supple", "pliant", "thin"; the Greek word is rare in this sense |
| ἣ θέμις ἐστί (23.581) | "as is the custom" | "as is the custom" | "as is right" (avoided for θέμις), "as is proper"; follows the table's ἣ θέμις ἐστί (2.73) |
| ὄμνυθι … πεδῆσαι (23.585; oath with γαιήοχον ἐννοσίγαιον) | "swear that you did not … fetter" | "swear … that you did not … hinder" | "bind", "hold back", "hamper" (kept for βλάπτω); πεδάω "fetter" in `l`, "hinder" in `i`; the god is left unnamed as in the table's γαιήοχος ἐννοσίγαιος (11.241) |
| χεῦμα · ἀμφιδεδίνηται (23.561–562; χεῦμα φαεινοῦ κασσιτέροιο) | "a pouring of shining tin" · "has been made to run round" | "a pouring of shining tin" · "runs all round" (+ note: the exact look is not given) | "a layer", "a band", "inlay", "edging" (each decides what the tin work is); χέω "pour", ἀμφιδινέω "whirl round"; κασσιτέρου "tin" as in the table |
| πολέος … ἄξιος ἔσται (23.562) | "worth much" | "worth a great deal" | "of great value", "precious"; ἄξιος with the genitive of value |
